Maybe there's a small triangle forming there. Normally, in a decline like that which I'm tracking as a sea wave, the price should get to the hundred percent extension. So that is the three cent level and this is a target for wave c here if we assume in the white counter b wave top that's the bearish interpretation then the market should get to three cents i mean we're now at nine it's not even too far away anymore if you think about it we were already at 50 cents up here in november 24 so again it's also been in a correction for a couple of, no, not one and a half years. And it's only a three wave decline though, so technically, of course, the market might attempt to come back, but first of all, we need to think about, okay, in the bearish count, which shows a downtrend towards 3 cents, roughly, what is a wave count, and we have here a possible wave move-up in the making because it's a C wave... and then what we need to define is what is our resistance area. Right? And the resistance is between 13.3 to 18.4 cents... so I... the bulls need to drive the price above it... I don't even have any evidence at this point that this wave four bounce even started. So you know we might... we may still get another low in wave three. This takes us to this upper support area here because normally what I'm saying is that a third wave should normally take us to the very least 123.6. and that level is at $0.005 so normally this third wave should take us a little lower 5.8 cents maybe even 4.7 cents here for another low and then there's also in this area around five and a half cents which is a 20 23 low probably quite a bit of structural support we can expect yeah i mean at the moment we're holding this swing low from August 24, and the 100% extension of the initial decline. Those are typically support levels, yeah? But they isn't really, you know, I'm always asking myself do I see a substantial buy reaction? But unfortunately not. So that can take us to the shorter timeframe for Doge. And if I'm looking at the shorter time frame, let's open it, there is this triangle. I think I talked about it before, I'm not covering DOGE much these days, because it's only moving sideways. Like many coins, but here, I would really treat this just noise. It's moving between two trend lines, and a triangle pattern is possible here, and we could get one more low. The triangle will be invalidate with a break above 11.8 cents. And if we see a move above it, then I'd assume that we've already started The Way 4 Even though... Sorry, my voice. Even though I'm based on standard guidelines I would, at this point, find one more low more likely. That being said, this could become a much more complex correction. At the moment, we're just consolidating one of the possible micro-structures I'm tracking here, is this ABCDE triangle. A break below the $0.08 level should take us roughly to $0.055 next.
